facts.statement: The entry reads PNG bytes through a sequential read sequence: read_info, read_update_info, start_read_image, repeated read_row, then read_end.

evidence.dependency_reason: The harness installs its byte callback and begins the read sequence.
The harness calls start_read_image before its row loop.

facts.statement: The supplied recipe disables STDIO, WARNING, and WRITE options in pnglibconf.dfa, then configures and builds libpng16.la before linking the fuzzer.

evidence.dependency_reason: The recipe fixes the build configuration and linked library.

facts.statement: Inputs shorter than eight bytes or failing the eight-byte PNG signature check return before the read sequence. The callback reads the remaining bytes and reports a read error when asked for more than remain.

evidence.dependency_reason: The callback defines how supplied bytes are consumed.
The entry gates reading on size and signature.
The read callback begins after the eight signature bytes.
The signature comparison checks the PNG signature bytes.

facts.statement: On both supplied source versions, png_read_info records the first IDAT length and stops its pre-row chunk loop at that chunk.
On both versions, png_read_update_info calls png_read_start_row when PNG_FLAG_ROW_INIT is clear; if the flag is already set, it reports a duplicate-call application error.
On both versions, png_start_read_image calls png_read_start_row only when PNG_FLAG_ROW_INIT is clear. When that flag is set, it calls png_app_error for the duplicate initialization.

evidence.dependency_reason: The harness then calls start_read_image before read_row.

facts.statement: On both versions, png_app_error calls png_warning if PNG_FLAG_APP_ERRORS_WARN is set and png_error otherwise. Thus the effect of the duplicate-call report depends on that flag.

evidence.dependency_reason: The same duplicate-call branch is present after the change.

facts.statement: Read-structure creation conditionally sets PNG_FLAG_BENIGN_ERRORS_WARN and, for a release build, PNG_FLAG_APP_WARNINGS_WARN. These shown assignments do not establish the initial value of the distinct PNG_FLAG_APP_ERRORS_WARN flag.

evidence.dependency_reason: The read-structure constructor calls png_create_png_struct and then makes the shown conditional flag assignments.
The same creation path and assignments appear after the change.

facts.statement: png_read_row itself calls png_read_start_row if PNG_FLAG_ROW_INIT is clear, so the source provides a route to row initialization through read_row. Whether the fixed harness reaches that route is governed by its earlier calls.

evidence.dependency_reason: The harness calls read_update_info before row reading.
The harness also calls start_read_image before row reading.

facts.statement: After initialization, png_read_row requires IDAT state, consumes IDAT data, combines the decoded row into a provided row buffer, and advances row state.
The harness rejects an image when width times height exceeds 100000000, then uses the pass count and height for its row-reading loop.

evidence.dependency_reason: The dimensions and pass count control whether the target attempts rows.

facts.statement: The harness has setjmp cleanup branches that return 0, and its normal path also returns 0 after read_end. The supplied calls alone do not show whether a duplicate-call png_error transfers control to those branches.

evidence.dependency_reason: The entry installs its error recovery points.
The row loop and normal return follow the duplicate-call site.

facts.statement: The complete fixed harness contains no explicit assert statement or check that a row was decoded successfully; it calls read_row and later returns 0 on the normal path.

evidence.dependency_reason: The entire audited harness is needed to support the limited absence claim.
